coordinated_activities.activity: Sleeping, air conditioner on low, phone on silent on the nightstand
Waking up, using the toilet, washing face and brushing teeth, taking morning medication with tap water, running the water heater for a quick shower
Drying off, dressing in work clothes for the on-site clinic and school shift, checking the day's appointment list on the phone
Making breakfast with the kettle and toaster, feeding the dog, eating quickly while reading reminder texts on the phone
Walking the dog around the block on the usual quiet route, keeping to well-lit streets
School-run drop-off duties at the primary school, then walking to the bus stop
Commuting by public transit to the community clinic, reading messages and planning the morning appointments
Working the on-site clinic shift: community healthcare appointments, intake paperwork, checking in on regular patients and their medication refills
Lunch break near the clinic, eating a packed lunch and sending one-on-one text check-ins to relatives
Continuing clinic duties, then crossing to the primary school for the education aide afternoon block with small reading groups
Finishing education aide duties, then a short community visit and pharmacy errand before heading home
Commuting home by public transit, replying to text messages and confirming tomorrow's schedule
Cooking dinner with Member 2, using the induction cooker and rice cooker, preparing a meal compatible with everyone's dietary needs
Eating dinner with Member 2 and Member 3 at the table, air conditioner on, phone face-down for a calm meal
Washing dishes with Member 3, wiping the counters, packing tomorrow's lunch, and taking the evening medication dose
Evening dog walk along the familiar neighbourhood loop, staying on well-lit paths
Sitting on the sofa sending one-on-one text check-ins to relatives and neighbours, logging volunteer notes in a notebook (joined by Member 3 until 20:15)
Showering with the water heater, running the dehumidifier and fan, winding down from the day
Watching TV in bed at low volume, updating the paper planner with appointments, cost-checking the cash budget for the week
Reading a devotional passage, quiet prayer, dimming the desk lamp and setting the phone alarm
Sleeping, air conditioner on low, light off
